content.short: Qredo is a web app that makes digital asset portfolio management fast and secure.
content.description: Qredo Wallet is a multichain MPC wallet that prioritizes security and enables cross-chain swaps. It integrates Ledger Live, a mobile and desktop application, allowing users to check balances in real time and to stake, send, and receive crypto. Users can trade peer-to-peer and move assets onto the Network at no cost. The platform also supports bringing their own governance systems, whether managed or self-custody, giving flexible control over assets.
